manifestations.invariant: When an amendment is rejected inside the notice window, the latest docket sequence is restored after a continuance rollback and its hearing chain is intact.

contract_bindings.quote: The calendar scheduler measures the required notice interval from the latest filed document.

This continuance rollback test confirms that a rejected packet preserves
the hearing chain.
